description:
TCOLogsPolicies is the Schema for the tcologspolicies API.
NOTE: The TCOLogsPolicies is the whole list of the API. Each write replaces every item of the list,
so an item that the spec does not have is removed. Deleting the TCOLogsPolicies removes every item.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.

spec.description: TCOLogsPoliciesSpec defines the desired state of a TCOLogsPolicies.

items.description: TCOLogsPoliciesPolicy is the Policy object of the API.

names.description:
The value(s) to match. For IS and IS_NOT rules, up to 50 comma-separated values. The service stores the values in lower case.
The API holds the values as one string, joined by ",".

archiveRetention.description:
Archive retention.
It refers to a ArchiveRetention by backend id, backend name, or custom resource.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: exactly one of name or id must be set

description.description: Optional free-text description of the policy's purpose. Only Latin-1 characters are accepted. A policy that `POST /dataplans/policies/v1` created without a description returns an empty string. A policy that an atomic overwrite created without a description can return none.

disabled.description: Indicates whether the policy is actively evaluated and applied. A create or atomic-overwrite request sets it as the opposite of its `disabled` value; `PUT /dataplans/policies/v1` sets `enabled` directly.

dpxlExpression.description: The DataPrime expression that selects the data. It starts with a version tag, for example `<v1> $d.severity == 'INFO'`; the service rejects an expression without one.

name.description: Human-readable name for the policy. Only Latin-1 characters are accepted.

priority.description: TCO priority level assigned to a policy, controlling how data is routed and archived.

usageTiers.description: Ordered list of usage tiers that map daily quota consumption percentages to priority levels. Percentages must be strictly increasing and priorities strictly decreasing, using only LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH.

items.description: TCOLogsPoliciesUsageTier is the UsageTier object of the API.

dailyQuotaPercentage.description: The daily quota percentage. Must be between 0 and 100.

severities.description: The severities. A request without `dpxlExpression` needs at least one, and a request with it must have none. A response with `dpxlExpression` has an empty list.

names.description:
The value(s) to match. For IS and IS_NOT rules, up to 50 comma-separated values. The service stores the values in lower case.
The API holds the values as one string, joined by ",".

targets.description: List of data targets/destinations to which this policy routes data. A log policy created without targets has one target: the `logs` dataset of the `default` dataspace, with the priority and the override of the policy. A span policy has one `spans` target. A RUM policy has none.

items.description: TCOLogsPoliciesV1Target is the v1.Target object of the API.

archiveRetention.description:
Optional archive retention configuration for the target. The service accepts it and does not store it: a target never returns it.
It refers to a ArchiveRetention by backend id, backend name, or custom resource.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: exactly one of name or id must be set

dataspace.description: The dataspace. Only `default` is supported, in any letter case; the service rejects another value with `400`. A log policy target reads back with the value as sent, and with `default` when it is omitted. Span and RUM policies reject targets in a request: a span policy reads back with one `spans` target in `default`, and a RUM policy with none.

priority.description: The base priority for the target.

priorityOverride.description: Optional quota-based tiered priority override for the target.

usageTiers.description: Ordered list of usage tiers that map daily quota consumption percentages to priority levels. Percentages must be strictly increasing and priorities strictly decreasing, using only LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH.

items.description: TCOLogsPoliciesUsageTier is the UsageTier object of the API.

dailyQuotaPercentage.description: The daily quota percentage. Must be between 0 and 100.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: dpxlExpression is mutually exclusive with severities, applications and subsystems

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:
message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.
This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.
